topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Hey, I heard the news about the job, and I just wanted to reach out. I know it's a lot to handle, and it probably feels like everything's crashing down right now. But I'm here, okay? And I'm not going anywhere. We all make mistakes, and I guess sometimes we think it's the only way to seem better or to fit in. But you don't have to, not with me. I want you to know that I care about who you are, not what you do or where you work. Let's figure this out together, and we'll make it right. You're not alone in this, I promise.
